8: 	-- Useful when ROBLOX lags out, and doesn't replicate quickly.
9: 	-- @param TimeLimit If TimeLimit is given, then it will return after the timelimit, even if it hasn't found the child.
10: 
11: 	assert(Parent ~= nil, "Parent is nil")
12: 	assert(type(Name) == "string", "Name is not a string.")
13: 
14: 	local Child     = Parent:FindFirstChild(Name)
15: 	local StartTime = tick()
16: 	local Warned    = false
17: 
18: 	while not Child and Parent do
19: 		wait(0)
20: 		Child = Parent:FindFirstChild(Name)
21: 		if not Warned and StartTime + (TimeLimit or 5) <= tick() then
22: 			Warned = true
23: 			warn("Infinite yield possible for WaitForChild(" .. Parent:GetFullName() .. ", " .. Name .. ")")
24: 			if TimeLimit then
25: 				return Parent:FindFirstChild(Name)
26: 			end
27: 		end
28: 	end
29: 
30: 	if not Parent then
31: 		warn("Parent became nil.")
32: 	end
33: 
34: 	return Child
35: end

126: 				end

137: 					error("[EasyConfiguration] - Index with a string")
138: 				end
139: 			end;
140: 		})
141: 
142: 		EasyConfigCache[Configuration] = NewConfiguration
143: 		return NewConfiguration;
144: 	end
